title: 7 Days to a Closer Walk With the Father
subtitle: A free 7-day prayer guide. You were never meant to carry it alone.
intro: Maybe you have prayed your whole life and it has gone flat. Maybe you have never prayed and you are not sure you are allowed to. Either way, you are in the right place. Each day has one verse, one short teaching, one guided prayer, and one action to take before the day ends.
days: Put Down What You Are Carrying
